content: Up to four phrase tables were jointly exploited by the multiple decoding path ability of Moses. Weights for the features were tuned using KB-MIRA BIBREF22 on the development set; we took the best weights after 15 iterations. Two hyper-parameters, namely, INLINEFORM0 for the number of pivot-based phrase pairs per source phrase and INLINEFORM1 for distortion limit, were determined by a grid search on INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 . In contrast, we used predetermined hyper-parameters for phrase table induction from monolingual data, following the convention: 200 for the dimension of word and phrase embeddings and INLINEFORM4 .
